chunks: They impress upon you that they have submitted. Tell them: "Do not favour me with your submission. In fact God has favoured you by showing you the way to belief, if you are men of truth."

key_terms.يَمُنُّونَ: They bestow favor / They impress upon you

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Yamunnuna 'Alayka' in Surah Al-Hujurat?
ai.summary: In the context of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, this verse corrects the companions' tendency to view their conversion as a favor to the Prophet, reminding them that true merit lies in God's guidance to faith. Shia scholars, such as Al-Tabarsi, highlight this as a lesson in humility, emphasizing that even the righteous should not boast of their piety but recognize it as a divine bestowal. This reinforces the concept that faith is a gift from Allah, not a human achievement.
